tool_input.command:
cat > /tmp/gov-os-assessment-I2/gate.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Wait until load1 < 20, MemAvailable >= 6710886 kB, and neither lock exists; print the state when it passes.
L=/home/usain/Dynamic-Agentic-Engineering-OS/.gov-runtime/scratch/orchestrator
while true; do
  load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)
  mem=$(awk '/MemAvailable/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo)
  ok=1
  awk -v l="$load" 'BEGIN{exit !(l<20)}' || ok=0
  [ "$mem" -ge 6710886 ] || ok=0
  [ -e "$L/CLOSE-RUNNING" ] && ok=0
  [ -e "$L/NIGHTLY-RUNNING" ] && ok=0
  if [ $ok = 1 ]; then echo "GATE-OK $(date -Is) load1=$load mem=${mem}kB close=$( [ -e $L/CLOSE-RUNNING ] && echo yes || echo no) nightly=$( [ -e $L/NIGHTLY-RUNNING ] && echo yes || echo no)"; return 0 2>/dev/null || exit 0; fi
  echo "GATE-WAIT $(date -Is) load1=$load mem=${mem}kB close=$( [ -e $L/CLOSE-RUNNING ] && echo yes || echo no) nightly=$( [ -e $L/NIGHTLY-RUNNING ] && echo yes || echo no)"
  sleep 30
done
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/gov-os-assessment-I2/gate.sh && /tmp/gov-os-assessment-I2/gate.sh
